Lead and Coal Avenues#
Lead and Coal Studies Final Report (March 2025 archived PDF)

Evaluates existing traffic, safety, noise, and multimodal conditions along Lead and Coal avenues, compares lane and two-way conversion alternatives, and recommends safety improvements using operations analysis, public input, crash history, and implementation costs.

Official City PDF · Official City NTMP studies index

Road Safety Audit of Lead and Coal Avenues (2022 archived PDF)

Documents the independent safety audit of Lead and Coal avenues between Broadway and Washington, including crash patterns, field observations, community comments, and recommended countermeasures for intersections, crossings, speeds, visibility, and multimodal travel.

Official MRMPO report

Lead Avenue and Coal Avenue Rest-in-Red Feasibility (July 27, 2021 historical report, archived PDF)

Evaluates rest-in-red signal operation on Lead and Coal avenues using 2021 speed counts, crash history, signal equipment, costs, and intersection priorities. Recommends starting during off-peak hours; this historical feasibility study does not establish present-day implementation or effectiveness.

Official City PDF

New Vision for Lead & Coal Avenues: A Quality of Life Document (March 23, 2007 historical report, archived PDF)

Presents the 2007 task force’s one-way and two-way redesign proposals, supported by corridor conditions, cross-sections, costs, and planning-level traffic analysis. Includes Wilson & Company’s separate recommendation for the one-way option; these proposals are not an adopted construction plan.

Original City source (currently unavailable) · Historical City PDF via Internet Archive
